Introducing [Glide Path](( https://semiseriousllc.com/glidepath/testflight ) - an homage to Flight Control .

Flight Control is my favorite mobile game. There are only few games that have even remotely come close to how much I played that game. For those who are curious, the ones that are distant seconds are: Tap Tap Revenge , Infinity Blade , and Mini Motorways .

Flight Control stopped working in 2015. IMHO, it’s left a giant hole for folks like me since then. So, I’ve been chipping away at creating an homage for the game. Appropriately, it’s ready for its Test Flight debut .

I am so excited. I am already hard at work with some performance improvements, new challenges in game center with some very early work on the next set of maps and game updates.

We also have a small community growing - ~ 40 at the time of writing based on global game center leaderboards.

Check it out if these fit your style.

items.title: More Stencilling
items.label: Blogs
items.excerpt:
🫧 Open on Bubbles

 

I'm experimenting with some more stencils for airbrushing the markings of my 1:144 scale aeroplanes.

This time I'm using laser-printable overhead-projector film, which is thin, impervious to water, and clear, and I can print the cutting guide lines on to it directly rather than having to use a reference sheet under it as I cut.

I've created the outline of the top wing of an Albatros D-III to scale and placed the crosses where I want them, and now it's just a case of carefully cutting the stencils. A very sharp blade and some strong magnification will be vital. 

When I was using it for stencilling on to fabric , I held it in place by spraying spray-glue on the back and letting it dry to create a non-slip surface. I don't think that would be sufficient for modelling purposes, and I'll just use a patch of double-sided tape for the job.

items.title: Building California School Trends
items.label: Small Web
items.excerpt:
We're trying to buy a house in one of the highest cost of living areas of the United States, and the schools aren't even good.

One thing we'd hear was "wealthier people are moving in who care about education, so this lower-performing school will improve". But was that true? How could we figure that out?

I ended up building California School Trends to solve for the problem.

Certain websites like Great Schools or Niche will show you their custom score, but it usually obfuscates the underlying fundamentals. Certain schools end up with a 7/10 that have top-decile test scores. Other schools with pretty mediocre test scores had a 9/10. Why? It was hard to tell. Were they trending up? Down? It was difficult to find out.

I ended up finding Page Turner, a non-profit that focuses on k-2nd grade reading proficiency. They had some pretty great stats, but only for reading proficiency, and it was a bit challenging to navigate their website.

Since 1949 the design of the year's US Federal Duck Stamp has been decided by competition among public art submissions . In 2020 a new rule mandated " an appropriate waterfowl hunting scene and/or accessory ". The entries ( 2020 gallery , 2021 gallery ) were subtle , uncanny , sinister , morbid , absurd , dramatic , creative , baffling , artistic and occasionally funny . The rule was revoked for the 2022 competition.

Here, have the 2026 entries as a palate cleanser. The previous years' galleries are great for browsing. I'm partial to this abstract effort (2023). Or this striking watercolour (2024). Sadly Travis Chapman's entry doesn't seem to have made the cut for the online gallery. I can't imagine why .

You struck a deal with a dragon: twenty years of protection for twenty years of dinner service. The island thrives under the beast's watchful eye, as long as the meals keep coming.

Every year, the dragon wakes up hungrier. You roll dice to work your island, harvest ingredients, fuse them into recipes, and cook them down in the Scorchpot — the pot you keep full or end up in. Get the meal right and you prosper. Get it wrong and you're smoke.

Build farmsteads, shrines, and harbors across your hex-grid island, each one changing how the board pays out. The best runs start with a handful of tiles and end with a machine that buries the dragon in food. Then the odds tighten, the dragon turns picky, and you tear the whole thing down and rebuild while it's on fire.

Feed the Scorchpot, keep the dragon happy, and outlast the contract.
